verdict.rationale: PlanetScale docs show CLI ability to create/delete databases and branches (docs-41) and manage backups (docs-12, docs-33), which gives some control over data lifecycle, but there is no documented retention policy (e.g., configurable backup retention periods, data purge SLAs, or GDPR/CCPA deletion guarantees) specific to AI-native usage. missing for 10: explicit data retention policy controls, documented backup/data expiry settings, and compliance-oriented deletion guarantees for AI agent data.
